concurrency.scope: Call-span overlap is active-job overlap, not simultaneous CUDA-kernel occupancy.

timing.scope: Elapsed times include concurrent contention; summing job times is not total experiment wall time. Preparation-to-compute excludes later actual image review and reporting.

memory.scope: Training peaks reset per real formal update including backward/AdamW; RAW per real rollout; D0 per single real forward with resident model. Allocator figures exclude CUDA context/external allocations. Device memory includes other concurrent workers/background processes. Estimated dispatch peaks are planning bounds, not measured process peaks.
